_about: Copper peptide product claims found unsupported while re-verifying the copper hub at source, 2026-09-22 (docs/audits/pages/README.md, 'Claims verified at source'). 'At a high published strength' has no source: no cited study or review states a studied concentration range. 'One of the most-studied peptides in skin science' is contradicted by Mortazavi et al. 2024 (PMID 39963574): 'a surprising absence of clinical studies'. Replacement wording is what the evidence supports.
